description: This file defines the ShippingRule class and related validation and calculation methods for handling shipping rules within an ERP system, including overlapping condition validation and tax table adjustments.

classes.name: OverlappingConditionError
classes.description: Custom exception for overlapping shipping rule conditions.

classes.name: FromGreaterThanToError
classes.description: Custom exception for invalid 'from' and 'to' value ranges.

classes.name: ManyBlankToValuesError
classes.description: Custom exception for multiple conditions with 'to_value' as zero or blank.

classes.name: ShippingRule
classes.description: Main class representing shipping rules with validation, application, and overlap checking methods.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the shipping rule, including condition ranges and overlaps.

methods.name: validate_from_to_values
methods.description: Checks that 'from_value' and 'to_value' are valid and non-negative, and enforces only one zero 'to_value' condition.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the shipping rule to a document, calculating shipping amount based on conditions.

methods.name: get_shipping_amount_from_rules
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping amount based on the value and conditions.

methods.name: validate_countries
methods.description: Validates if the shipping address country matches the rule's applicable countries.

methods.name: add_shipping_rule_to_tax_table
methods.description: Adds or updates the shipping charge in the document's tax table.

methods.name: sort_shipping_rule_conditions
methods.description: Sorts conditions by 'from_value' in increasing order.

methods.name: validate_overlapping_shipping_rule_conditions
methods.description: Checks for overlapping ranges among shipping rule conditions and raises an exception if found.
